MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 15

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 19

4. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 19
   C. 8
   D. 12

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

6. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 5

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

17. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 3

18. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

20. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

21. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

22. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 8

23. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

24. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 37

25. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

26. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

27. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

28. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16

29. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

30. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
